title: Play, rules and you
intro: Game night, free time and the rules nobody reads. Let's see how you play.

cards.prompt: Game night, last round of Uno. Your friend stacks a +4 on your +2 and wins. Half the table swears that's legal. It isn't.

options.t: Pull up the official rules. Read them out loud.
Draw six. Stacking is the best part of Uno.
Let it count, then settle the stacking rule before next game.
Let it slide. They haven't won a single round all night.

cards.mask: looks like Uno drama; measures L3: the rule as written versus the rule the room is enjoying (Sally Q02 rebuilt as an everyday fairness card)

friend.prompt: Game night. A friend wins Uno with a stack that isn't in the official rules. {name}...

a.t: Pulls up the official rules and reads them out

b.t: Draws six. Stacking is more fun anyway

cards.prompt: Your crew is getting ready to go out. The ride is 10 minutes away. You're the one...

options.t: Ready in six minutes. Hoodie, keys, done.
Doing a full fit check in every mirror we pass.
Wearing the outfit I planned on Tuesday. Accessories included.
Still in the shower. We'll be fashionably late.
Fixing everyone else's hair and collars.

cards.mask: looks like a getting-ready meme; measures how much time and care the look is worth to you (Sally Q29, T14), with slight planning and helper evidence

friend.prompt: The crew is getting ready to go out, ride in 10 minutes. {name} is...

a.t: Ready in six minutes, hoodie on

b.t: Doing a full fit check in every mirror

cards.prompt: You're offered a year in a city you've never been to. Place to live, sorted. Your life here is honestly good.
cards.teenPrompt: Your school offers a year-long exchange in a city you've never been to. Host family, sorted. Your life here is honestly good.

options.t: Go. Pack tonight, learn the bus map when I land.
Stay. My people, my spots, my Thursday thing.
Visit for a week first. Then decide.
Depends who I'd be leaving behind.
Can't right now. Money or family keeps me here.

options: My closest people tell me to go
I could come home for every holiday
A friend moves there with me

cards.mask: looks like a dream-offer daydream; measures L1 steady versus venture when nothing forces the move (Sally Q46)

friend.prompt: {name} is offered a year in a city {they}'ve never been to. Life here is good. {name}...

b.t: Stays. The people and routines are here

cards.prompt: Think of the last time a rule made zero sense for your exact situation. A house rule, a school policy, a store sign. It wasn't your call.

options.t: Asked whoever runs it for an exception.
Followed it, rolled my eyes, moved on.
Worked around it quietly. Nobody got hurt.
Bent it, then told them why before anyone asked.

cards.mask: looks like a pet-peeve story; measures L3 in action: work the rule through its owner versus handle it yourself and explain (Sally Q38)

friend.prompt: A rule makes zero sense for {name}'s situation, and it isn't {name}'s call. {name}...

a.t: Asks whoever runs it for an exception

cards.prompt: Sunday night. The week ahead has three deadlines, two plans and one thing you've definitely forgotten. What do you actually do?

options.t: Color-code the whole week. Backup times included.
Look back at last week to see what went wrong.
Nothing. Monday me is very capable.
Ask the group chat what I'm doing this week.

cards.mask: looks like week-planning chaos; measures track-and-read-the-trend versus go by feel in daily life (Sally Q31/Q32 reframed, never health)

friend.prompt: Sunday night, and {name}'s week ahead is a mess. {name}...

b.t: Trusts Monday to sort it out

cards.prompt: Think of the last free afternoon you got. Nothing planned, nobody needing you. What did you actually do with it?

options.t: Went deep on my own thing. Game, sketch, gym, guitar.
Helped with someone else's thing. A move, a stall, a fundraiser.
Texted around until a group plan happened.
Stayed horizontal. Snacks, shows, zero guilt.
Caught up on work or homework I was behind on.
Got pulled into a shift or family stuff. Not really free.

cards.mask: looks like a lazy-afternoon recap; measures whether free time goes to your own growth or to helping others (Sally Q47, T23), with slight L2 and R1

friend.prompt: {name} gets a free afternoon, nothing planned. {name}...

a.t: Goes deep on a hobby, solo

cards.prompt: You have one spare ticket to the sold-out show. One friend asked first, weeks ago. Another is having the worst month of their year.

options.t: First to ask gets it. That was the deal.
The friend having the awful month. They need tonight.
Flip a coin on video, post it in the group chat.
Give up my own ticket so both of them go.

cards.mask: looks like concert logistics; measures L3: keep the queue order or go by who needs it more right now (Sally Q40 as an everyday last-spot card)

friend.prompt: {name} has one spare ticket. One friend asked first, another is having an awful month. It goes to...

b.t: The friend having the awful month

cards.prompt: The ticket's handed over. What showed up first?

options.t: Guilt. Someone's going to be quietly hurt.
Relief. It's out of my hands now.
Irritation. Why is this my job?
Worry about what the group chat will say.
Pride. That was the right call.

cards.mask: looks like a mood check; records the emotion attached to choosing between order and need (emotion only, no profile score)

cards.prompt: Pick the two that are the most you.

options.t: My comfort show is on its fifth rewatch.
I pick the restaurant none of us has tried.
I know my screen time down to the minute.
My calendar is mostly vibes and sticky notes.
I'll give up a Saturday to help anyone move.
My free time is booked. By me, for me.

cards.mask: looks like a quick self-roast; gives T22, T24 and T23 a second card each (new versus favorite, tracked versus by feel, helper versus own time)

cards.prompt: Group project. The brief says 10 slides. Your group's idea would be way better as a 3-minute video.

options.t: Make the 10 slides. The brief is the brief.
Make the video. Good work speaks for itself.
Ask whoever set the brief before touching anything.
Make the slides. Hide the video link on slide 10.

cards.mask: looks like group-project politics; sealed check on L3 (the brief as written versus what the situation needs)

cards.prompt: Your go-to spot, the one that starts your order when you walk in, closes forever. First morning after, you...

options.t: Try a different place every day until one clicks.
Go to the closest one and order the exact same thing.
Track down where the staff went and follow them.

cards.mask: looks like a small everyday loss; sealed check on T22 (new versus mine) with slight L1
